page.layout: One page of text, running head at top; the text ends with the place and date line; below it a woodcut ornament; at right, below the text, the large capitals heading "EPISTO-".

main_text.p: negotium Christi promovent. Accipe igitur gratiac be-nevoli in te animi testimonium hoc quantulumque, Commentarium in posteriorem Pauli ad Thessalonicen-ses epistolam, simulque analysin Logicam in ejusdem Apostoli ad Philemonem epistolam ; cui utrique tuum nomen ideo inscribere volui, ut si quid utilitatis ex his meis laboribus ad alios perveniet[?], id tibi quoque ex parte aliquâ imputetur, & feratur acceptum. Vale, Edinburgi, 1598. 14. Calend. Augusti.
main_text.head: EPISTO-

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is an engraved headpiece without text and is not transcribed. The faint lines of print on the lower half of the page and the faint shapes at the right margin are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are left out. The heading "EPISTO-" is cut off at the right edge of the scan; its continuation is not visible, so I have transcribed it as far as it can be read. The word "perveniet" is partly obscured by the ligature in the scan, so its last letters are doubtful. The word "gratiac" is copied as it appears in the scan and may be a printing error or an abbreviation.
